test_cases.title: Complete checkout with three distinct randomly selected products
preconditions: The SauceDemo application is available at the configured test base URL.
A user can establish the authenticated state required by the feature through the visible login flow.
The authenticated product listing contains at least three visible products.
test_data_requirements: Use only products currently visible in the authenticated product listing; select three different products at runtime without relying on fixed product names.
Retain the three selected product names as runtime reference values and compare those values at the cart and checkout overview stages.
Use valid non-secret runtime values for all mandatory buyer information fields; do not store credentials or personal data in the test artifact.

steps.action: Authenticate through the visible login flow.
steps.expected_result: The authenticated product listing is displayed.

steps.action: Read the products currently visible in the product listing.
steps.expected_result: visibleProducts contains the products available for selection in the listing.

steps.action: Select three different products at runtime from visibleProducts and retain their names as selectedProductNames.
steps.expected_result: selectedProductNames contains exactly three distinct product names that were visible in the listing.

steps.action: Add each product in selectedProductNames to the cart.
steps.expected_result: Each of the three selected products is added through the visible product-listing flow.

steps.action: Inspect the visible cart quantity indicator.
steps.expected_result: The cart quantity indicator visibly reflects 3 items.

steps.action: Open the cart through the visible cart entry.
Read the product names visible in the cart as cartProductNames.
steps.expected_result: cartProductNames contains the products currently represented in the cart.
The cart visibly contains the same three distinct product names selected from the listing.
The checkout information step is displayed.

steps.action: Complete all mandatory buyer information fields with valid runtime test data.
steps.expected_result: The mandatory buyer information is accepted and the checkout can proceed.

steps.action: Read the product names visible in the checkout overview as overviewProductNames.
steps.expected_result: overviewProductNames contains the products currently represented in the checkout overview.
The checkout overview visibly contains the same three distinct product names selected from the listing.

steps.action: Finalize the purchase from the checkout overview.
steps.expected_result: The purchase completes and the application displays the visible purchase confirmation state.
A visible confirmation indicates that the purchase was successful.

expected_results: Three distinct products selected at runtime from the authenticated listing are represented in the cart.
The cart quantity indicator visibly reflects 3 items.
The cart and checkout overview contain the same three product names retained from the listing selection.
Valid mandatory buyer information permits continuation to the checkout overview.
Finalizing the purchase displays a visible confirmation of successful purchase completion.

metadata.evidence_basis: Feature and Discovery specify the complete positive flow; Exploration observed authenticated listing access and cart representation for Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light with a visible quantity indicator of 2, while checkout stages and runtime values were not observed.
